parameters.query:
WITH created AS (
INSERT INTO metrics.workflow_runs (workflow_key, execution_key, model_name)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT (workflow_key, execution_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id AS run_id, workflow_key, execution_key, model_name, emails_total, emails_summarized, emails_failed
)
SELECT created.*, true AS acquired FROM created
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::uuid, $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, 0, 0, 0, false
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM created);

nodes.name: Get unread emails
nodes.notes: Read-only: this workflow never marks emails as read, sends or deletes anything.

parameters.query:
UPDATE metrics.workflow_runs SET emails_total = $2
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'running' RETURNING id AS run_id, workflow_key, execution_key, model_name, emails_total, emails_summarized, emails_failed;

UPDATE metrics.workflow_runs SET emails_summarized = $2
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'running' RETURNING id AS run_id, workflow_key, execution_key, model_name, emails_total, emails_summarized, emails_failed;

UPDATE metrics.workflow_runs
SET status = $2, finished_at = clock_timestamp(), emails_total = $3,
    emails_summarized = $4, emails_failed = $5, error_code = $6
WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'running'
RETURNING id AS run_id, workflow_key, execution_key, model_name, emails_total, emails_summarized, emails_failed, status, error_code;
